laws.rule: Shanghai Hongqiao and Pudong airports and Shanghai Port are 240-hour visa-free transit ports; the permitted area is all of Shanghai, and travel on to other permitted provinces is allowed within the 240 hours.

Smoking, including e-cigarettes, is banned in indoor public places, indoor workplaces and on public transport (articles 2 and 6). Outdoor bans cover children's venues, women's and children's hospitals, the seating and performance areas of stadiums and venues, heritage sites open to the public, and waiting areas for crowded public transport (article 7). A person who smokes in a banned place and ignores a request to stop is ordered to stop and fined (article 19).
laws.penalty_signal: CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
